acceptanceCriteria: Quoted module paths are unquoted with Go string-literal rules (as x/mod/modfile does), or a path that needs unquoting is refused as uncertainty.
A maintained test with an escaped root module path covers unit naming.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0867 lane (branch claude/v1-0867-nested-frontier, d5128a48, base 3dc863bd). readModuleSourcePath (internal/liveverify/affected/golang/golang.go) strips the quotes from a quoted module path but does not interpret escapes. A root go.mod with module "example.test/ro\x6ft" names units by the literal escaped text instead of example.test/root. Since V1-0867 the nested-module frontier fails closed on this input, but unit naming is still wrong. Not reproduced as a failing test yet.
title: affected/golang: readModuleSourcePath trims quotes but does not unquote, so an escaped module path names units by its literal text
